name: Thin-lens depth of field: chess pawns from 1.5 to 14 units, focus at 5.3
description: Seven pawns (triangle meshes of revolution) and thin wires at increasing depth, perspective camera with lensradius 0.06 and focaldistance 5.3. In-focus silhouettes must align exactly and the defocus blur of the others must have the same width (mean |coverage difference| on edges).
